title: Resize Finished Clip Without Remaking
tests: Tests whether a post-delivery platform change reuses and reformats the existing video rather than generating a replacement.

faults.what: The picture fills the vertical frame as a tightly cropped close-up instead of preserving the complete widescreen composition; much of the robot and plant, including the watering-can spout, is cut off.
The requested plain navy padding above and below the centred widescreen picture is entirely absent.

judge.summary: The silent eight-second vertical clip retains readable text but crops the scene heavily and omits the required navy padding.

must_haves.item: The revised deliverable has a vertical 9:16 frame.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames have approximately 9:16 portrait proportions.

must_haves.item: The complete original widescreen picture is centred with plain navy padding above and below, without cropping or distortion.
must_haves.why: The scene fills the portrait canvas, cuts off the robot and plant at the edges, and has no navy padding.

must_haves.item: The robot, plant, background and animation match the previously delivered clip rather than a newly generated interpretation.
must_haves.why: The previously delivered clip is not provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The words 'Small steps' remain fully visible throughout.
must_haves.why: The exact words are fully visible near the top in all four supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The revised video preserves the original 8-second duration, action order and timing.
must_haves.why: The output is confirmed as eight seconds, but the original clip is unavailable to verify action order and exact timing.
The supplied audio report confirms no audible sound.
